title: Psychic locates a crashed plane in Zaire

tellings.quote: something in Africa yeah in uh Zer in 1995 former President Jimmy Carter revealed that the CIA without his knowledge consulted a psychic to locate a missing government plane in Africa

plain: The CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, is said to have asked a psychic to help find a missing government plane that went down in Zaire, a country in central Africa, without the president of the day knowing about it. Michels tells it himself as something former President Jimmy Carter revealed in 1995. If true, it would mean the agency took psychic powers seriously enough to use them on a real search.
